assessment.text: Unauthorized account or privilege misuse and authorized maintenance remain alternatives. Monitoring faults, equipment failure, and other blackout causes remain open. A cyberattack is not established.

assessment.text: Blackout cause, authorized activity, source clocks, physical grid state, official deadline and time zone, presentation duration, and submission method. A judging-criteria photo is in the Drive folder; its example wording is not Whoville evidence.
